summary.intent: Autonomously run the full post-execution ship pipeline for GSD Phase 68 (web rotation UX / durable anti-rollback client state) in cipher-box: verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit review, ship, resolve all PR review threads (CodeRabbit + Greptile), and extract learnings — without user babysitting.
summary.outcome: Shipped PR #587 with all gates passed (security 41/41 closed, validation 0 gaps, SDK E2E 12/12, CodeRabbit CLI 28→0 in-scope); fixed several real bugs (crypto zeroization-order bug, missing signature-verification guard, anti-rollback transaction gap, NaN/negative fail-closed validation); resolved 13+ PR review threads across multiple CodeRabbit/Greptile re-review rounds; work was interrupted by the user during a final late-thread sweep before the closing report (final SHA/CI status/merge decision) could be delivered.

repo: SDK E2E suite (`pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-e2e test`) is the only suite exercising the real client→API IPNS publish/resolve round-trip; unit suites mock the boundary and miss integration regressions — never skip this gate when a phase touches IPNS publish/resolve, sequencing/CAS, or key lifecycle.
CI's Test job never runs apps/web vitest and root `pnpm typecheck` excludes apps/api tsc — pre-existing failures in those areas are not ship blockers but should still be captured as todos.

tee-worker is a separate Docker container with its own release cadence (Phase 67 lease-renewer contract); a stale container silently 404s on `/republish` and must be rebuilt (`docker compose build tee-worker && up -d`) when local SDK E2E fails on renewal tests.

Rotation floors/context (ResolveRotationContext, high-water marks) are keyed by `ipnsName`, not a separate node id — CodeRabbit repeatedly flagged this as a bug but it matches the documented SealedChildRef contract.

`gh` CLI calls inside the sandboxed Bash tool can hit `dial tcp i/o timeout`; the error string gets misparsed as an empty/'0 pending' result by naive polling loops, producing false 'all settled' positives — happened at least twice in this session.

CodeRabbit and Greptile both re-review new commits pushed to a PR, generating fresh findings each round; a ship pipeline needs to loop fix→push→reply/resolve→poll until a round produces zero new findings, not just once.

code.finding: enumerateMoveDescendants zeroed the parent readKey in a `finally` block before the children loop's `unsealChildReadKey` call finished using it, misclassifying every depth-2+ move descendant as unreadable — real bug found by the simplify pass, fixed with red-green-verified regression tests.

reconcileFolderSequence called enforceResolved on a resolve without the `signatureVerified` guard the read path already had — a forged relay record with an inflated sequence could permanently wedge mutations by bumping the durable floor; fixed late in review (Greptile P1) with a regression test.

enforceResolved did not reject NaN/negative/fractional generation or sequence values, silently bypassing the anti-rollback regression gate; hardened to fail-closed on malformed input, including a malformed cold-device versionFloor.

updateGrant lacked a transaction/lock and an anti-rollback check on rootGeneration; wrapped in `dataSource.transaction` with `pessimistic_write` lock and a `ConflictException` when the new rootGeneration regresses.

idbPut wrote floors without max-preserving against the existing value inside one transaction; fixed to read-then-Math.max-then-put atomically to avoid regressing a durable floor under concurrent writes.

workflow: A background command reporting exit code 0 can still mask a real failure if downstream reporting (e.g. `tail`) truncates output — always read the full output file, not just the exit-code notification.

Red-green verification (temporarily revert the fix, confirm the new test fails, restore the fix, confirm it passes) is a reliable way to prove a regression test actually catches the bug it targets, not just that it's green.

Triage rule that worked well: in-scope + low-risk findings get fixed immediately with a committed regression test; pre-existing/out-of-domain/risky findings get a dated todo file under `.planning/todos/pending/` with file refs, never silently dropped or silently fixed.

When polling GitHub check status via backgrounded/unsandboxed gh calls, harden the loop against transient network timeouts (verify with a direct unsandboxed re-check) before trusting a 'settled' signal.

friction: First SDK E2E run appeared to pass (exit 0) but actually had a failing renewal test masked by truncated log output — required manual investigation to surface.
Local tee-worker container was running a stale pre-Phase-67 contract, causing spurious renewal test failures unrelated to the phase's code.
API's TEE_WORKER_URL defaulted to :3001 (mock-ipns-routing) instead of the real tee-worker at :3002, causing another false failure requiring diagnosis.

apps/web's ipns.service.test.ts failed locally with a confusing 'No createAxiosInstance export' mock error; took extensive diffing against main before concluding it was pre-existing and outside CI, not a phase regression.

Sandboxed Bash's gh calls timed out on network access, and the resulting error string was misinterpreted by a polling loop as 'reviews settled,' producing at least two false-positive completions that had to be caught and re-verified.
Edit tool repeatedly failed with 'File modified since read' because lint-staged/commit hooks rewrote files during the commit step, requiring re-reads and re-edits.
zsh quirks (bare `echo ===X===` interpreted as a command, working directory persisting into apps/api and breaking relative paths) caused minor command failures.

CodeRabbit and Greptile kept surfacing new findings after each fix-and-push cycle, extending the review-resolution loop across many rounds (28→2→0, then 7 more threads, then 2 more late Greptile findings) before it could close out.

Session hit its usage/session limit mid-pipeline, requiring a user 'continue' to resume, and was ultimately interrupted by the user during the final late-thread sweep before the closing report could be delivered.
